entries.back_en: They say the monster in the capital is actually a ghost summoned by the spirit of the First Emperor!
entries.note: Omite 'running around' (correndo pela capital); só 'na capital'.

entries.back_en: General Rhun is our only hope... If he falls... No! We can't think about that. Besides, he killed monsters to spare... Everything will be fine... Right?
the beings that guide and shape our world--
were to disappear? I don't know the answer to that.
